notes: Seed URL co.ellis.tx.us/index.asp?nid=312 and every co.ellis.tx.us page tried (/312/Elections, home) returned HTTP 403 (bot protection, not bypassed). One web search found the county's current domain www.elliscountytx.gov, which loads; its Prior Election Results pages link per-election pages. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Election-night results are hosted on livevoterturnout.com ENR (ellistxenr/4 and /5 for the 2026 primary, /9 and /10 for the runoff), which shows per-precinct results; the pages now show 'Official Results for Canvass' with 'Website Updated: 3/10/2026 2:10:56 PM' (Last-Modified Tue, 10 Mar 2026 19:10:57 GMT) and expose no dated update history, so check 1 cannot be read. County pages now list only official canvass PDFs (Official Cumulative/Summary Results, Official Precinct by Race Results, reconciliation forms) for all three elections; the election-night unofficial results have been replaced, so check 2 cannot show what was public on election night. Check 3 pending (origin/wayback-data not present). Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-B): no election decided; tag and results unchanged. Tried: (1) livevoterturnout ENR page source (ellistxenr/4/en/Index_4.html, 6.7 MB static HTML): all results are embedded in the page; the only data file it loads is '../ellistxenr_4.txt' (a GeoJSON map layer for 'Districts'); the shared script LiveResultsScripts_v4.1.js returns 404; no update history or per-update files exist, and today's copy is the canvass state ('Website Updated: 3/10/2026 2:10:56 PM'). (2) archive.org/wayback/available (reachable) shows a Wayback capture of ellistxenr/4/en/Index_4.html at 20260304054915 UTC (11:49 PM CST, election night), but web.archive.org replays and archive.ph are refused by the fetch module (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable), so its content cannot be read here; no capture near election night for ellistxenr/5 (Democratic primary), /9 or /10 (runoff). This 2026 primary capture is the best lead for the targeted Wayback harvest (not yet on the branch for Ellis). (3) Check 4 search found only county notices and a 'Preliminary Election Reconciliation Unofficial Totals' PDF (DocumentCenter/View/22968, CreationDate Mar 4 2026 05:07 UTC; turnout only, no candidate votes, no Last-Modified header). Sweep pending.
